final_message: The bug was an off-by-one error in `moving_average` in `stats.py`: the loop used `range(len(values) - window)`, which skipped the final window. Changing it to `range(len(values) - window + 1)` includes every window (including the case where the window equals the list length). All 4 tests now pass.
